units.source_text: 皇上急欲看看新生的小皇子，等得十分心焦。

en.t: The Emperor was eager to see the newborn little prince and grew deeply anxious as he waited.

units.source_text: 源氏公子心中怀着不可告人的隐衷，也渴望一见自己的亲生儿子，

en.t: Prince Genji, carrying an unspeakable secret in his heart, also longed to see his own son,

units.source_text: 便找个无人注目的机会，到三条院问候，

en.t: so he found a moment when no one would notice and went to Sanjo Palace to pay his respects,

units.source_text: 教人传言：“万岁爷急欲知道小皇子状况，我今先来一看，以便回宫奏闻。”

en.t: and had someone send word: "His Majesty is anxious to know how the little prince is doing. I have come first to see him, so that I may return to the palace and report."

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子传语答道：“婴儿初生，面目未整，尚不足观……”

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo sent back the reply: "The baby has only just been born, and his features are not yet settled; there is still nothing worth seeing..."
Her refusal in this way was reasonable enough in itself.

units.source_text: 其实，这婴儿的相貌酷肖源氏公子，简直如同缩图，一望而知。

en.t: In truth, the baby's face looked exactly like Prince Genji's, almost like a miniature portrait, and anyone could tell at a glance.

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子大受良心苛责，痛苦万状。

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo was harshly tormented by her conscience and suffered beyond measure.

units.source_text: 她想：“别人只消一看这小皇子的相貌，便会察知我那荒诞的过失，岂有不加谴责者？

en.t: She thought, "If others merely see the little prince's face, they will realize my outrageous fault; how could anyone fail to condemn me?

units.source_text: 莫说此种大事，即使是小小的过失，世人往往吹毛求疵。

en.t: To say nothing of such a grave matter, people in this world often pick at even the smallest mistake.

units.source_text: 何况我这样的人，不知将何等遗臭万年呢！”

en.t: How much more, then, will someone like me leave behind a shameful name for ages to come!"

units.source_text: 反复思量，但觉自身乃世间最不幸之人。

en.t: As she turned these thoughts over again and again, she felt that she herself was the most unfortunate person in the world.
